reviews.title: Quality built case, some restrictions being SFF but it looks great and easy to build
reviews.comment: Love this case with the fish tank look. Build quality is really nice, I was kind of worried with company named JONSBO sometimes you're taking your chances. Lots of spots for fans, especially if you want to get creative. 4 120mm, 2 top 2 bottom. Then you can get 2 92mm in the bottom of the second compartment cooling psu and behind the motherboard. Another 2 92mm fans attached to back air intake area, I'm using those small square velcro pads and have no noise issues or anything coming loose. Finally 2 80mm fans in front air intake area blowing at cpu and back of gpu. All this and my pc is literally at ambient at idle. 50-60 during heavy gaming. I am using the P9 and P8 max fans which are pretty heavy duty but they're pretty quiet at middle of rpm range. So it stays super cool with 12600K and 1080ti. Great case, I left out the bottom 120mm fans cuz i didnt want them blowing straight into my 1080ti and knocking a gpu fan off balance. Obviously glass is dust and fingerprint magnet. Plus its kinda a pain to take on and off if you want to fiddle. Other than that easy peasy build with a SFF psu but its not a necessity.
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.title: Beautiful case with great features
reviews.comment: EXCELLENT and beautiful case design with very good build quality.  Compact in size, perfect for an M-ATX motherboard.  It was a big pleasant surprise to see that the all the normally individual cables for Power SW, Reset, LED, HHD LED were all combined into a solid Plug-in connector (matching the Asus MB. This should be a STANDARD procedure with all PC cases.  It's so frustrating when you have to plug each of those 9 individual cables into the correct PIN one at a time in the proper order! The Power button lights up white (not bright) with Power ON, and Blinks when computer is in a dormant state to let you know.  Smart, Awesome feature. More expensive than most cases, but as usual, you get what you pay for.
reviews.author: M. Alberto

reviews.title: Glass does not go back on easy.  Other than that, I love it.
reviews.comment: Love the look and function of the case.  Easy to pull of the back and sides and put all the parts in.  Running the wires was a breeze, before you put the fans in.  The only thing that is not cool about this is the glass front does not go back on easily because the holes for the screws on the left and right DO NOT perfectly match up.  On mine the glass hangs very slightly lower on the left, maybe off by 2mm or something.  It's noticable if you're looking for it from the front visually.  VERY noticable when you're trying to secure the glass back on after making changes.
